Loss report: gha -> concourse

[lost] pipeline/ci/trigger/1 trigger.filter.branches (the branch pattern release/** has no resource: a git resource follows one exact branch)
[external] pipeline/ci/job/build job.runner: no worker tag (the hosted label ubuntu-latest runs on any Linux worker; the GitHub-hosted image tools are not present)
[emulated] pipeline/ci ext.passthrough: git-uri variable (the git resources read their uri from ((git-uri)); set it with fly set-pipeline -v git-uri=<uri> or in the credential manager)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/build trigger.push: workspace from the first triggering resource (the tasks run in the checkout of source-main, and every build uses the newest version of each resource, so a push to source-release-old builds the newest commit of source-main)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/build/step/build-step-1 step.image: default image (the task names no image, so it runs ubuntu:latest)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/build/step/build-step-1 step.shell: run.path sh with a bash-if-present wrapper (the source runs the step under bash when the image has it; the task runs bash -e when the image has bash, else sh -e, so bash-only syntax fails under sh)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/trigger/1 trigger.push: one git resource per branch (the branches main, !release/old are 2 git resources, and the job runs once per branch event)
